name: Accelerometer trim units are tenths of a degree and not labelled in degrees
step: Check accelerometer trim units and documentation
rationale: The accelerometer trim payload stores signed values in tenths of a degree, but the user-facing page and documentation must describe them consistently. This standalone harness loads the real trim codec and checks that Roll and Pitch each retain the -300 to 300 range, zero default, and tenths-of-a-degree documentation without a degree suffix.
